MARKETING/CUSTOMER INFORMATION SYSTEMS Second Quarter Accomplishment / Third Quarter Objectives

BUSINESS ANALYSIS

1995 Second Quarter Accomplishments

- Loaded March and April, 1995 MARLIN data into production in DataServer and MRS.
- Sct up and tested MARLIN on RBM PC's locally and at Winston-Salem officc. Technically ready to roll out to all RBM's.
- Modified lorsyth Products Jobber Incentive reports for Peer Account information and YTD information and added new reports and maintenance tables to support their business requirements.
- Implemented in parallel with the current production VSR system a new batch update process that involved posting CSS sales to the new VSR ADABAS file and building a new brand/gcography summary process. Created 1st Quarter, 1995 Volume Ranking Reports for Trade Relations.
- Began investigation and timing of work to convert MRS to Excel 5.0, revising views where required. Currently scheduled with LAN/Server upgrade at the ROU's.
- Determined RJR scope of work and implemented extract routines and files required by IRI to support the BIAD/IRI Proposal approvėd to load RJR Shipment, MSA Shipment, Estimatcd Consumption and Annual data from ANALECT to IRI Data Server EXPRÉSS. Coded and tested VSR and MSA extracts that will support IRI DataServer/EXPRESS and dircct VAX 1oads
- Evaluated the IR1 Proposal for running MARLIN using IRI Bridge to Chicago database and determined it to be not cost effective.
- Implemented in MRS the following vicws and enhancements: a new "MARLIN Region Tracking Report"; a modified MSA Military SOM vicw to include RJR Savings excluding Monarch, Winston Select, Winston Basc and Salem Preferred; an enhanced Competitive Offers vicw to remove MARLIN statistics and use advanced Excel text fcatures; and a ncw Project Tracking graphical status.
